clips.title: The story
paras: The Ruins of Jubuwal are the crumbling remnants of an ancient Gurubashi settlement located just east of the Gurubashi Arena in Stranglethorn Vale. Once a place of empire and ritual, the ruins have fallen under the sway of the rogue witch doctor Zanzil the Outcast and his bizarre retinue of minions.

Situated off the primary thoroughfare cutting through Stranglethorn Vale, Jubuwal was once part of the grand Gurubashi civilization. Today, stone carvings and ivy-draped masonry have been overtaken by Zanzil the Outcast, an eccentric witch doctor known for his potent concoctions and foul voodoo. Zanzil has filled the ruins with an unnatural menagerie of followers, including enthralled ghouls, subjugated naga, and renegade trolls. Desperate fugitives also lurk among the stone arches, such as Jon-Jon the Crow and Maury 'Club Foot' Wilkins, both hiding from the ruthless debt collector 'Sea Wolf' MacKinley back in Booty Bay.
